examples.en: On the weekend I watch a movie with a friend.
On weekends I get up late.
I don't go to the office on weekends.
What do you do on the weekend? — I go shopping with my younger sibling.
My younger sibling has a part-time job on weekends.

explain: “주말”의 “말”은 end예요. 월말, 연말, 학기말도 같은 구조예요. 주말은 토요일과 일요일이에요.

phrases.en: a couple who live apart and meet only on weekends

phrases.nuance_en: a married couple who live apart for work and meet only on weekends
phrases.en_equiv: a couple who live apart and meet only on weekends

dict_examples.ko: 나는 지난 주말에 아내와 같이 영화를 보았다.
dict_examples.en: Last weekend I watched a movie with my wife.

explain_en: The 말 in 주말 means “end”: the end of the week. Same pattern in 월말 (end of month) and 연말 (end of year).

examples.en: On weekdays Ben works at the office.
I don't drink on weekdays.
I go to school on weekdays.
I don't exercise on weekdays.
What do you do on weekdays? — I work at the library.

explain: “평일”은 월요일부터 금요일까지예요. 영화관, 호텔, 식당은 “평일”과 “주말” 가격이 달라요.

dict_examples.en: An atmosphere different from a normal weekday.

dict_examples.ko: 이 가게는 평일보다 주말에 손님이 많다.
dict_examples.en: This shop has more customers on weekends than on weekdays.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.en: I go to work on weekdays and rest on weekends.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 평일 means Monday to Friday. Cinemas, hotels and restaurants often have different prices for 평일 and 주말.

examples.en: Today is a day off. I'm not going to school.
On days off I rest at home.
The shop is closed on holidays.

examples.ko: 휴일에 회사에 가요? — 아니요, 안 가요.
examples.en: Do you go to work on days off? — No, I don't.
On days off I have meals with my family.

explain: “휴일”은 쉬는 날 모두예요. 나라가 정한 쉬는 날은 “공휴일”이라고 해요. 설날과 추석이 공휴일이에요.

dict_examples.en: He sleeps in every holiday morning.

dict_examples.ko: 장마가 끝난 후 첫 휴일이라 그런지 유원지에 엄청난 인파가 몰렸다.
dict_examples.en: Perhaps because it was the first holiday after the rainy season, huge crowds flocked to the amusement park.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: 휴일 is any day off. A national public holiday is a 공휴일, such as 설날 (Lunar New Year) and 추석 (Chuseok).

examples.en: I come to this restaurant often.
It rains often these days.
I often call my friend.
I often study at the library.

examples.ko: 운동을 자주 해요? — 아니요, 가끔 해요.
examples.en: Do you exercise often? — No, only sometimes.

explain: “자주 안 해요”는 not often이에요. 가끔은 해요. 한 번도 안 할 때는 “전혀 안 해요”라고 해요.

dict_examples.en: Something that happens often.

explain_en: 자주 안 해요 means “not often”, so you do it sometimes. If you never do it, say 전혀 안 해요.

examples.en: I usually rest at home on weekends.
I usually have bread in the morning.

examples.ko: 저는 집에서 주로 한국 드라마를 봐요.
examples.en: At home I mostly watch Korean dramas.
My younger sibling mostly plays games in the evening.

examples.ko: 주로 어디에서 점심을 먹어요? — 회사 식당에서 먹어요.
examples.en: Where do you usually have lunch? — At the office cafeteria.

explain: “자주”는 how often이고, “주로”는 what/where you mostly do예요. 취미나 습관을 물을 때 “주로 뭐 해요?”라고 해요.

dict_examples.en: What I mainly do these days.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 그는 주로 회사에서 세끼를 모두 해결했다.
dict_examples.en: He mostly ate all three meals at the company.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 나는 방학 동안 주로 음악을 들으며 책을 읽었다.
dict_examples.en: During vacation I mostly read books while listening to music.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.en: Apart from the time I spent on light hikes, I mostly stayed shut up in my room.

explain_en: 자주 is about how often; 주로 is about what or where you do something most of the time. “주로 뭐 해요?” is a standard small-talk question.

examples.en: I shop at the department store.
On weekends I go shopping in Myeongdong.
I shop online.
I'm going shopping with a friend today.
My older sister shops really often.

explain: 마트에서 음식 재료를 살 때는 “장을 봐요”라고 해요. 옷이나 신발을 살 때는 “쇼핑해요”라고 해요.

dict_examples.ko: 백화점 세일 기간에는 쇼핑하는 사람이 평소보다 많아 매우 혼잡하다.
dict_examples.en: During department store sales, there are more shoppers than usual and it is very crowded.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: For buying groceries at a supermarket, Koreans say 장을 봐요. 쇼핑해요 is for clothes, shoes and other things.

The baby is napping right now.

We eat cake at the party.

examples.en: Who's coming to the party? — Friends and family.

I go hiking every week.
Do you have hiking boots? — Yes, I do.
Are you going hiking? — Yes, to Bukhansan.
I don't hike. I swim.

explain: “등산해요” 대신 “산에 가요”라고도 많이 말해요. 두 말은 거의 같아요. 한국에서는 등산을 정말 많이 해요.

dict_examples.en: An early-morning hike.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.en: To go hiking.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

dict_examples.ko: 나는 주말에 가족들과 등산이나 낚시를 즐긴다.
dict_examples.en: On weekends I enjoy hiking or fishing with my family.
dict_examples.src: 국립국어원 우리말샘 (CC BY-SA 2.0 KR) · 영어: AI 번역

explain_en: Instead of 등산해요 you will often hear 산에 가요; they mean nearly the same. Hiking is hugely popular in Korea.

examples.en: Why are you learning Korean?
Why don't you eat kimchi?

explain: 이유를 물을 때 문장 앞에 ‘왜’를 써요. 대답은 ‘-아/어서요’로 해서 ‘피곤해서요’라고 해요. 말투에 따라 따지는 느낌이 날 수 있으니, 어른에게는 부드럽게 물어요.

dict_examples.src: AI 생성 · 검수

dict_examples.ko: 왜 웃어요? 제 얼굴에 뭐가 있어요?
dict_examples.en: Why are you laughing? Is there something on my face?

explain_en: Put 왜 at the front to ask why. Answer with -아/어서요: '피곤해서요' (Because I'm tired). Depending on tone it can sound like a challenge, so ask elders gently.
